Hello Product Hunt! 😎 Super pumped to launch ProDocktive today! We wanted a better way to interact with external displays, so we built an app that turns your iPhone into the ultimate desktop-style controller. No extra hardware, no clunky workarounds—just a clean, intuitive interface that puts you in command. With ProDocktive, you get: A seamless, desktop-class navigation experience directly from your phone screen. A beautifully minimal interface designed to keep you focused. Instant compatibility with your existing external display setups. We built this for people who value speed, focus, and premium design. Let us know what you think in the comments—ask me anything! 👇

When building ProDocktive, our biggest inspiration was Apple itself. Apple hardware is incredible, but we felt there was a missing link when it came to interacting with external displays. Our goal was to create an app that feels like a native part of the Apple ecosystem. We heavily leaned into that modern, premium aesthetic and frictionless user experience. From the fluidity of the air mouse to the familiar, intuitive layout of the custom dock, we wanted ProDocktive to feel exactly like a tool Apple would have built themselves.

When building the interaction model for ProDocktive, we were heavily inspired by the Meta Quest. Traditional remotes and trackpad apps always feel a bit clunky, but the Quest showed everyone how intuitive and frictionless spatial computing could be. We wanted to bring that exact same 'magic' to your everyday external displays. By turning your iPhone into an advanced air mouse with built-in hand tracking, we’ve brought that fluid, VR-style navigation right to your desk—no headset required.
